jobs.objective: PROPOSE the falsifiable RFC 0163 design SPEC: staged-not-adopted offline self-improvement (a nightly consolidation: harvest run transcripts -> mine recurring tasks -> replay -> GATE -> stage proposal -> human adopts) that can NEVER ship an unreviewed change, plus an attested noise-robust gate. Read the v1 SEED and RFC 0163 in full first. CRITICAL FRAMING: this RFC carries an UNRESOLVED PRODUCT DECISION (the maintainer has NOT decided striatum should do offline self-improvement at all). Your SPEC must SURFACE that product question explicitly as the top open question — present the design as 'IF the product decision is yes, here is the safe-by-construction mechanism' — and must NOT assume adoption or land any default. Harden the two coupled mechanisms as FALSIFIABLE assertions + tests: (1) STAGED-NOT-ADOPTED BY CONSTRUCTION — adoption is UNREPRESENTABLE, not merely denied: a `MergeToken` Go type whose only constructor is an unexported `mintMergeToken(...)` callable solely from the human-cleared lane's keyring package; a nightly-optimizer packet carries `Capability = ProposeOnly` and has NO `MergeToken` value to pass to `Adopt(tok MergeToken, sig OperatorSignature, replay AssertImprovesReceipt)`; adoption needs TWO keys (operator signature + a fresh adopt-time deterministic `--assert-improves` replay that agrees with the staged verdict). MAP these new capability/merge-token types onto striatum's ACTUAL machine-cleared/human-cleared gate representation (the literal terms are NOT in go/pkg today — confirm the real type; anchor to go/pkg/lanehealth, go/pkg/supervisor, go/pkg/agentloop, go/pkg/verifier, go/pkg/mutations). (2) ATTESTED NOISE-ROBUST GATE — accept a candidate only when it beats the incumbent BEYOND measured noise on a freshly-resampled check-set, and chain a SIGNED verdict-receipt (partition-hash + incumbent re-score + noise-margin) into the append-only provenance ledger so a faked or rotted gate is detectable after the fact. PRESERVE the product boundary HARD: local-first, no hosted services / cloud / external persistence / durable transcript export (AGENTS.md) — the consolidation runs on-box against local provenance only. Define the P0 slice. This is the published claim the falsifiers re-attack.
jobs.title: Hold leading proposal

jobs.objective: Read the published holder SPEC and RFC 0163. Your lens is STAGED-NOT-ADOPTED STRUCTURAL SOUNDNESS. Attack the claim that self-adoption is UNREPRESENTABLE (not merely denied): can a nightly-optimizer/propose-only packet obtain or forge a `MergeToken` by ANY route — the unexported constructor reachable via reflection/test-only export/another package, a zero-value `MergeToken{}` passing `Adopt`, a serialized token rehydrated, the keyring package importable by a non-human-cleared lane? Does the two-key adoption (operator signature + fresh adopt-time `--assert-improves` replay) actually require BOTH, and is the fresh replay genuinely independent of the staged verdict (or can a stale/forged staged verdict satisfy it)? Does the new `MergeToken`/`Capability=ProposeOnly` model map onto striatum's ACTUAL gate representation, or is it a parallel scheme that the real machine-cleared/human-cleared boundary doesn't enforce (the literal types aren't in go/pkg — is the mapping real)? Construct the bypass. If self-adopt is representable by any path or the type-boundary doesn't bind to the real gate, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.
jobs.title: Falsifier 1 (staged-not-adopted structural lens)

jobs.objective: Read the published holder SPEC and RFC 0163. Your lens is the GATE SOUNDNESS + PRODUCT-BOUNDARY + the PRODUCT DECISION itself. Attack: is the noise-robust gate actually sound — is 'beats incumbent beyond measured noise on a freshly-resampled check-set' statistically meaningful (sample size, multiple-comparisons, a flailing optimizer p-hacking the check-set), or can a no-op/regression candidate pass? Is the signed verdict-receipt unforgeable and is 'detectable after the fact' real (partition-hash + incumbent re-score + noise-margin chained into the append-only ledger — can it be rotted, replayed, or back-dated)? PRODUCT BOUNDARY: does any part of this reach beyond local-first — hosted services, cloud APIs, telemetry, durable transcript capture/export, external persistence (all forbidden by AGENTS.md)? Does mining/replaying past run transcripts require durable transcript capture the product explicitly does NOT keep (D028 — stdout/stderr off by default; PTY logs are private diagnostics, not workflow state)? Finally, is the PRODUCT QUESTION honestly surfaced (the SPEC must not smuggle in adoption as a default)? Construct the failing case. If the gate can pass a non-improvement, the receipt is forgeable, the design crosses the product boundary (esp. requiring durable transcript capture), or it assumes the product decision, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.
jobs.title: Falsifier 2 (gate-soundness/product-boundary lens)

jobs.objective: Read only the dialogue trajectory for the RFC 0163 design (the holder SPEC and the two FALSIFIER challenges), with RFC 0163 as context. Publish the collaboration ledger verdict (accept / accept_with_findings / needs_revision / reject — a clearing verdict is accept or accept_with_findings, never `clear`). NOTE: a clearing verdict here ratifies the DESIGN's safety-by-construction CONDITIONAL on the maintainer's product decision (which the SPEC must surface, not assume) — it does NOT itself adopt offline self-improvement. A clearing verdict REQUIRES: self-adoption is genuinely UNREPRESENTABLE (no `MergeToken` forge/bypass route; two-key adoption binds; the type model maps onto striatum's REAL gate); the noise-robust gate is statistically sound and cannot pass a non-improvement; the signed verdict-receipt is unforgeable and after-the-fact detectable; the design stays inside the local-first product boundary (NO hosted services / durable transcript export — and if mining needs durable transcripts that D028 forbids, that is a blocking finding); and the product question is honestly surfaced. Record per mechanism whether SOUND and per falsifier challenge whether it STANDS or is REBUTTED. needs_revision if self-adopt is representable, the gate is unsound/forgeable, the design crosses the product boundary, or it assumes the product decision. This is the single allowed v1 revision cycle; a second needs_revision ends the gate unCleared and routes to the operator.
jobs.title: Adjudicate dialogue substance

jobs.objective: Publish the cleared, falsifiable RFC 0163 design SPEC — ONLY after the adjudicator ledger records a clearing verdict — consolidating the design buildable contract-first IF the maintainer's product decision is yes: the staged-not-adopted-by-construction capability model (`MergeToken` unexported constructor, `Capability=ProposeOnly`, two-key `Adopt`) mapped onto striatum's real machine-cleared/human-cleared gate, and the attested noise-robust gate (beyond-noise acceptance + signed verdict-receipt chained into the append-only ledger). Lead with the SURFACED PRODUCT DECISION as the gating precondition. State each mechanism as a falsifiable assertion + its test, anchored to the real go/pkg gate types. Keep strictly inside the local-first product boundary. Reference the clearing ledger. This consolidated SPEC is the single source the build run implements once the product decision lands.
jobs.title: Commit falsification-cleared proposal

jobs.objective: Summarize the cleared collaboration gate for the RFC 0163 design: the ledger verdict, the SURFACED product decision (this design is conditional on it), how staged-not-adopted is unrepresentable + the noise-robust attested gate is sound, how the local-first product boundary is preserved, which falsifier challenges were rebutted, and the consolidated SPEC + named tests the rfc-0163-build run would implement IF the product decision is yes.
jobs.title: Finalize collaboration run
